## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 10 specifics

- Located 90.8% (22.8% by fuzzy match), label + body 84.3%, analysis 74.0% (re-run 25 Sep with the fixes of brief §27).
- **Against the typed witnesses** (`docs/witness-join.md`, `docs/witness-pndaza.md`): labels agree on 99.0% of 6,208 rows where both have one; analyses are ≥ 0.8 / < 0.4 similar in 90.4% / 0.5%. Pn Daza's page-referenced copy gives a typed text for 677 of the articles the OCR could not place.
- P. 219, a page the index gives no headwords (printed ၁၇၁), carries one entry: ဒသ², which the index files with ဒသ³⁻⁵ under p. 220 (image, 25 Sep; `ID_PAGE_FIX`, id 81975; before, the note here said two). ဒသ¹ is on p. 218. On p. 220, 81977 and 81978 hold the articles of ဒသ³ and ဒသ⁴ and 81976 is unplaced: the homonyms are paired one entry late (the typed witness agrees: body ratio 0.36 and 0.24). Not corrected; NEXT-SESSION item 5b.
- The last hundred pages are the weakest (84%): long ဒွတ္တိံသ… compounds (p. 936, 2 of 8).

## Spot check

One page, p. 578 (a page near the middle of the book with 9–14 headwords): 10 of 10 at the right entry; labels 10, all as the typed witness.
Checked in the text (each placed row opens on its headword, with its label) and against the typed witness page by page; the image was not opened.
For this batch the spot check is one page per book, not three: vols. 10–19 are checked page by page against the typed witness instead, and the three books without one (14/3, 20, 22) on the image.
